entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf improvement: kestrel-encoded-url #67566
  • Unhandled-security-metadata guard misses AuthorizationPolicy and IAuthorizationRequirementData #67559
  • [FromQuery] Model binding property is filled with a random value when query doesn't contain the property #67556

Closed

  • Encoder abstraction for SignalR.StackExchangeRedis pub/sub messages #28669
    Backlog
  • Data Protection: CreateProtector reads the key store eagerly on .NET 11 (was lazy until first Protect/Unprotect on .NET 10) #67447
  • The "pattern" paramter of Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder.EndpointRouteBuilderExtensions.MapFallback is ignored when EnableRequestDelegateGenerator is true #65992
    11.0-preview7
  • Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http 2.3.x packages don't clearly indicate they are only intended for ASP.NET Core on .NET Framework #67370
  • tablo #67563
  • package Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Core 2.3.11 does not contain Extensions dictionary in ProblemDetails #67560
  • Documentation lack of clarity regarding KestrelServerLimits.MaxRequestLineSize in HTTP/2 #67204
  • [area-blazor]'Unable to connect to 'https'' when running Blazor WebAssembly Standalone project with https #67484
  • OpenApi: OAS 3.1 enum component schema changes depending on nullable/non-nullable references #67557
  • [NETSDKE2E][ARM64 Only] NET10.0.301 throw "warning NU1903: Package 'Microsoft.OpenApi' 2.0.0 has a known high severity vulnerability" in C# Web API project #67543
  • Thanks for your PR, @socialsigninsupporthub. Someone from the team will get assigned to your PR shortly and we'll get it reviewed. #67554
